name: OpenHive
description: Runtime for colonies of agents in which a persistent Queen agent spawns worker clones to run a business process in parallel.
whatItDoes: Automates long-running business processes with a group of specialised agents coordinated by one client-facing Queen. Aimed at teams that want parallel agent work without wiring a graph.
howItWorks: There is one execution primitive: the Queen is an agent loop and each worker is a clone with the same tools and model. Coordination uses a shared tracker ledger and a persistent task plan. Setup uses a uv workspace and a quickstart script, not pip.

requirements.name: ripgrep
requirements.description: Needed for full search; the quickstart installs it
